newsitem.title: USA: Associated Estates Q1 net, FFO rise.
newsitem.headline: Associated Estates Q1 net, FFO rise.

text.p: Net income applicable to common shares (A) 3,854 3,420

(A) After dividends of $1,371 equivalent to $0.09 and $0.10 per common share, respectively, for the three months ended March 31, 1997 and 1996, respectively, on the Company's 2.25 million depositary shares each representing 1/10 of a share of 9-3/4 percent Class A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Shares.

(B) Effective January 1, 1996, the Company determines Funds From Operations using the new guidelines adopted by the National Association of Real Estate Investment Trusts. FFO is defined as income before gains (losses) on sales of investments and extraordinary items (computed in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles) plus real estate depreciation less preferred dividends and after adjustment for significant non-recurring items, if any.
(C) Does not include the Company's proportionate share of mortgage indebtedness of the Joint Venture properties of $17,917 and $17,969 at March 31, 1997 and December 31, 1996, respectively.
